WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW

Join ALO’s Artificial Intelligence and Data Science team to explore the frontiers of applied AI in wellness, fashion, and retail. You’ll build intelligent systems that power personalization, content generation, computer vision, and decision automation.

We’re looking for a hands-on AI Engineer who loves to build. You’ll design and deploy bespoke, high-impact AI solutions that stretch across product design, marketing, supply chain, customer experience, and engineering. Some projects will be fast-turnaround proofs of concept; others will grow into scalable internal platforms. You’ll balance the art of creative experimentation with the discipline of technical rigor—knowing when to build from scratch and when to leverage what already exists.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build bespoke AI solutions to accelerate business outcomes—anything from product image generation to conversational assistants or process automation.

• Prototype rapidly using APIs, open models, and cloud-native services to validate ideas and demonstrate value.

• Design for scale—transition ad hoc experiments into maintainable, production-grade systems or reusable components.

• Evaluate external AI platforms and tools for integration potential, cost, and business fit.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, design, supply chain, retail operations, and engineering teams to translate real problems into AI-enabled solutions.

• Implement responsible AI practices that ensure transparency, fairness, and explainability across applications.

• Mentor and coach peers in practical AI adoption and experimentation.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 10+ years of experience in a data or software engineering field.

• MS or PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or Data Science.

• Equal parts builder, hacker, and architect—you can ship a working demo in a day but think in systems that can scale for years.

• Comfortable working without a map—you thrive in ambiguity and see constraints as creative opportunities.

• Skilled in Python, SQL, and cloud AI platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and fluent in modern AI frameworks (LangChain, Hugging Face, OpenAI, etc.).

• Strong grasp of ML fundamentals (classification, NLP, computer vision, embeddings) and practical data engineering.

• Experience in integrating AI into business workflows—e.g., automating content generation, demand forecasting, or intelligent search.

• Naturally curious about the intersection of human creativity and artificial intelligence, and driven by impact, not novelty.

• Experience in implementing / developing model evaluation frameworks.

Why ALO

Join a team shaping the intersection of wellness, fashion, and technology. At ALO, data isn’t just numbers—it’s the heartbeat behind immersive experiences, purposeful products, and global community connection.

3M has a long-standing reputation as a company committed to innovation. We provide the freedom to explore and encourage curiosity and creativity. We gain new insight from diverse thinking, and take risks on new ideas. Here, you can apply your talent in bold ways that matter.

Job Description:

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role 

As a Content Creator Specialist, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world.

Content is King. Content is a vehicle that delivers 3M’s voice to the consumer’s mind. This position will be responsible for coordinating with Area Portfolio owners and agencies to ensure the creation of high-quality digital product content, including titles, descriptions, bullets, images, A+ content, media assets, and copywriting. The E-Commerce Content Creator will oversee the end-to-end content production process, ensuring that all content aligns with our marketing goals and communication strategies. 

Here, you will make an impact by:
• Coordinating with Area Portfolio owners, AMC eCommerce team and external agencies to develop and create engaging digital product content that aligns with our brand and marketing goals.
• Overseeing the creation of eCommerce content (product marketing text, product images, A+ Content, and other digital assets) to ensure it aligns with 3M EMEA’s marketing goals, communication priorities, and customer platform requirements, including Amazon.
• Leading communication with internal and external stakeholders to ensure consumer-centric content creation and manage the entire development process.
• Translating product communication strategies and key claims into clear, accurate, and benefit-led content tailored for Amazon and other digital retailers.
• Writing, editing, and proofreading optimized product titles, bullet points, descriptions that follow Amazon SEO best practices and category conventions.
• Reviewing and approving content produced by agencies to ensure it meets content quality standards and brand guidelines.
• Contributing to EMEA-level content capability improvement projects, including Amazon content excellence programs.
• Monitoring e-commerce content performance metrics (e.g., search ranking, conversion, content quality scores, A/B tests) to inform ongoing optimizations.

Your Skills and Expertise 
To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M is looking for candidates who meet following minimum requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field.
• Experience in content design and creation, with a focus on e-commerce or digital marketing. This is a mandatory requirement.
• Amazon content optimization experience is a plus.
• Proven experience in working with different internal stakeholders and coordinating with external agencies.
• Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills in English. Additional languages are a plus.
• Strong understanding of SEO and Amazon search optimization practices.

Preferred qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and ability to collaborate across teams and functions.
• Creative mindset with a keen eye for detail, using an iterative approach to continually improve content quality and performance.
• Ability to express design concepts logically and persuasively.
• Proactive and able to anticipate business needs.
• Knowledge of graphic design and image editing software.
• Understanding of digital marketing strategies and tools.

About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.




THE OPPORTUNITY

The Data Science team is growing at 9fin! We are doing world-class work with groundbreaking technologies to build data-driven products using machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, speech and audio, and knowledge/data mining. We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to accelerate our application of AI across teams and products. Come and join us, you will get to build large-scale AI powered systems, learn and apply the latest techniques, and work alongside other great researchers and engineers!

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

 - Design and build generative AI applications tailored to complex financial and legal workflows, leveraging state-of-the-art models to deliver innovative, practical solutions that streamline decision-making and unlock new efficiencies.

 - Drive end to end model development lifecycle, leading the team in best practices, ensuring reproducible research and well managed model delivery/deployment.

 - Collaborate cross functionally to share diverse ideas, understand business problems, and elevate/mentor your teammates.

 - Translate complex problems into well-defined scoped bets in an internal startup style environment, dynamic and fast-paced.

 - Learn and apply ground-breaking research and approaches in advanced topics, iterating improvements with a fail fast mentality.

 - Be a proactive sharer of compelling ideas/work to the rest of the team and organisation. We want you to help lead/push the adoption of AI throughout 9fin.


ABOUT YOU

This role will be a great fit if you:

 - Strong proficiency in Python for production ready delivery.

 - You’re an expert in any of the following areas - deep expertise in one and familiarity with others is ideal:
   
   - Information Retrieval: chunking strategies, (finetuning) embedding models, training re-rankers.
   
   - Entity/relationship extraction/resolution
   
   - Knowledge Graphs; building and inference, graphRAG
   
   - Recommendation systems and ranking: personalisation, learning-to-rank, feed ranking, user modelling, etc.
   
   - Tabular ML: feature engineering, structured data modelling (GBDTs, etc.)
   
   - Statistical & Predictive Modelling: supervised ML, anomaly detection, temporal modelling, etc.
   
   - Deep understanding of the GenAI landscape and agentic frameworks.

 - Experience working in the full model lifecycle (including experimentation, training, testing, monitoring, and deployment). We are data centric and love our evals!

 - You have a strong product focus with a desire to understand the end-to-end impact of your solutions for our end users.

 - Good knowledge of AWS’s AI infrastructure.


BENEFITS

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

 - Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

 - Equity

 - Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

 - Private Medical Insurance

 - Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

 - Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

 - Hybrid working model

 - 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

 - Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture 

 - Professional learning and development budget

 - AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

 - Quarterly team socials

 - Summer and Winter company social events
   

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Finance Data Scientist

The practice
Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role.

Purpose of the role

Advances the Decision Intelligence capability from driver-based planning and package configuration towards ML-driven forecasting. Owns the forecasting models from problem framing and data preparation through model validation, production integration, monitoring and adoption. The role works alongside the Planning & Performance Management practice and extends the range of propositions the practice is able to take to market, combining statistical rigour with finance-process understanding and decision-ready explanation.

Responsibilities

Build forecasting models on client financial and operational data, covering revenue, cost, cash, demand signals and underlying drivers, using appropriate classical, econometric, machine-learning or deep-learning approaches rather than a single preferred method.
Prepare and validate multi-source data, engineer internal and external drivers, address seasonality and structural change, and model hierarchical relationships across products, entities, geographies or cost centres.
Design rigorous back-testing and time-series cross-validation, compare against transparent benchmarks, and evaluate accuracy, bias, stability, calibration and business impact; reconcile forecasts across hierarchies where required.
Run scenario and sensitivity analysis to a standard that supports CFO-level interrogation, including stress cases, uncertainty ranges, forecast interventions and causal or counterfactual analysis where appropriate.
Produce variance explanation and commentary capable of withstanding challenge from an FP&A team, including plan-versus-actual decomposition, driver attribution, explainability, confidence and limitations.
Integrate models into the client planning cycle and EPM platform to support operational adoption, working with Data and ML Engineers on pipelines, APIs, model registry, versioning, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and controlled override workflows.
Work with AI Engineers where forecasting intersects agentic workflow, including proactive variance alerting, hypothesis ranking and draft narrative generation, while retaining appropriate finance review and approval.
Document methods, data, assumptions, model limitations and validation evidence, and measure whether the solution improves decision quality, planning efficiency or forecast performance in use.

Essential experience

Depth in time series and forecasting methods, spanning classical and modern approaches, with the judgement to select appropriately, including seasonality, external regressors, rolling horizons and model trade-offs.
Python and the associated analytical stack, with experience of production or near-production deployment, together with SQL, Git, testing and reproducible analytical or ML pipelines.
Strong understanding of forecast evaluation, including time-series cross-validation, back-testing, benchmark selection, error and bias metrics, uncertainty and stability over time.
Experience working with large, multi-source datasets and implementing input, output and consistency checks that address data-quality risk in forecasting pipelines.
Ability to explain model behaviour to a finance audience and defend underlying assumptions, uncertainty, limitations and the practical implications for decisions.
Ability to work with FP&A, operational and technical stakeholders to align models with planning calendars, business assumptions, adoption workflows and measurable outcomes.
At least 4 years’ relevant professional experience

Desirable

FP&A or financial planning domain knowledge, including driver-based planning, rolling forecasts, management reporting or variance analysis.
Causal inference or uncertainty quantification, Bayesian or probabilistic forecasting, hierarchical reconciliation, optimisation or simulation.
MLOps or cloud data-science experience using platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure ML, SageMaker or Vertex AI.
Experience with Anaplan, OneStream, Pigment, Oracle EPM or SAP Analytics Cloud, including integration of external models or analytical services.
Experience with anomaly detection, automated narrative generation or agentic workflows for forecast monitoring and intervention.

ACCURX IS WHERE CONVERSATIONS HAPPEN WITH AND ABOUT PATIENTS IN THE NHS

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient, has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts.

Our platform now powers Total Triage https://www.accurx.com/primary-care to manage patient demand, and Self-Book https://www.accurx.com/booking that lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires https://www.accurx.com/questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail https://www.accurx.com/accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe https://www.accurx.com/scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.



GAMECHANGING, RIGHT? HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL BE GETTING STUCK INTO TO MAKE IT WORK

As an Implementation Manager, you’ll be the one making sure our most ambitious tools actually land and stick in Secondary care. You won't just be ticking boxes on a rollout list; you’ll be leading the charge on high-impact transformations, like helping clinicians and admin teams move over to Accurx Scribe https://www.accurx.com/scribe. You'll spend your time figuring out how these tools fit into the daily lives of clinicians, making sure they aren't just "installed," but are genuinely making things better for everyone.

 - Driving deep transformation: Leading big-scale rollouts for complex products like Scribe, making sure we’re not just doing the basics but fundamentally changing how healthcare is delivered.

 - Strategic boundary-setting: Standing firm on implementation plans and managing commercial expectations to ensure we deliver sustainable solutions without overcommitting.

 - Owning the AI journey: Becoming the go-to expert on our emerging AI features, taking full ownership of how they are introduced to practices and scaled across the country.

 - Closing the feedback loop: Reviewing practice cohorts 6-9 months after go-live to see if they’re actually using the product as intended and figuring out how we can make it even better.

 - Scaling with smarts: Using our internal AI dashboards to handle the "heavy lifting" of data, so you can focus on the human side of implementation while we automate the repetitive bits.

 - Raising the bar: Constantly looking for ways to improve our processes—if something isn't working or could be more efficient, you’ll have the autonomy to change it.

 


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF...

 - You’ve been around the block with big rollouts: You have solid experience managing complex implementations in a fast-paced business and you know how to keep a project moving.

 - You’re a "driver," not a "passenger": You don't wait to be told what to do; you dive into the context, spot the problems, and take the lead on solving them.

 - You can hold your own: You’re comfortable having tough conversations with stakeholders and can stay firm on what’s achievable

 - You’re a natural communicator: You can explain technical or complex changes in a way that feels clear, simple, and actually exciting for the people using them.

 - You’re relentlessly resourceful: When you hit a roadblock, you don't just stop - you find a creative way over, under, or through it.

 - You care about the "why": You’re motivated by the idea of fixing healthcare communication and want to see the real-world impact of your work on clinicians and patients.




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. Job Description
The Senior Counsel, Artificial Intelligence & Data Privacy will lead and advise on global data protection and AI governance across the global jurisdictions in which AECOM operates, ensuring compliance with international privacy laws and emerging AI regulation, mitigating legal risk and supporting responsible innovation. 
The role is also the embedded legal partner to AECOM's AI Engineering teams located across Europe. It helps those teams develop and deploy AI-driven products quickly while protecting AECOM's intellectual property, its clients and the people whose data it handles, giving clear, practical answers and streamlining the legal review and compliance process. 
The postholder will be the gateway and quarterback between the AI teams and the wider global AECOM legal team, and a senior, business-facing partner to leaders across the business. A cultural fit with the AI teams is essential, and a technology or product background is valued. 
1. Lead product counsel embedded within AI development teams 
Act as the embedded legal partner to the AI Engineering teams across the whole product lifecycle, managing legal design and compliance issues, and making pragmatic, risk-based calls rather than adding process. 
Build self-service playbooks, decision guides, standard templates and pre-approved positions so that engineers and product teams can get most answers without waiting for legal review. 
Support product launches into new markets with fast, risk-based guidance on local legal requirements, product terms and AI transparency obligations. 
Advise on the IP position of AI development, including rights to training data, model and dataset licenses, open-weight model license terms (use restrictions and attribution), open-source software compliance, and ownership of AI-generated outputs. 
Protect clients' confidential information and IP by setting clear rules for how client construction information may be used, including for model training and fine-tuning, and ensuring product behavior matches AECOM's contractual commitments. 
Provide generalized legal support to the AI teams, including review & negotiation of vendor and other commercial agreements, contracts, and provide advice and counsel on general legal matters where needed. 
Act as gateway and quarterback between the AI teams and the wider global legal team: bring in the right internal specialists, leadership at all levels, and external counsel across jurisdictions, and keep spend proportionate to the risk. 
Guide the legal team and senior stakeholders on privacy, AI governance and regulatory developments, and give strategic advice on integrating privacy and AI compliance into product development and operations. 
Lead and coordinate legal professionals within the AECOM legal function with full or partial responsibility for related tasks and deliverables. 
2. Global privacy and AI regulatory compliance 
Advise on global privacy laws, including GDPR and UK GDPR, US federal and state laws such as CCPA/CPRA, LGPD in Brazil, PIPEDA in Canada, the Australian and New Zealand Privacy Acts, and key Asian regimes such as Singapore's PDPA. Advise on lawful basis, DPIAs, cross-border transfers and data residency. 
Advise on AI regulation and governance, including the EU AI Act, UK AI principles, emerging US federal and state AI rules, and emerging risk frameworks, turning them into practical requirements that teams can build into their normal way of working. 
Contribute to the development and maintenance of the company's privacy and AI governance frameworks, policies and procedures. 
Conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments and AI Impact Assessments for new projects and technologies, and recommend technical and organizational measures to mitigate privacy and AI-related risks. 
Establish procedures to respond to client AI-related requests and restrictions, ensuring contractual and regulatory obligations are met promptly and effectively. 
Track and interpret legal and regulatory developments and enforcement trends in AI, IP and data protection across AECOM's markets, and brief internal stakeholders on what matters and what needs action. 
Represent the company in regulatory inquiries and investigations related to data privacy and AI. 
Deliver privacy and AI governance training to employees and business units and promote a culture of privacy and responsible AI by design and default. 
Qualifications
A senior, experienced, qualified lawyer, with a law degree and admission in a relevant jurisdiction. 
Deep knowledge of GDPR, UK GDPR and US privacy laws, with experience of cross-border data transfers, and of emerging AI regulatory frameworks such as the EU AI Act and how they apply to products in practice. 
Deep expertise in intellectual property and technology commercial work, including software, data and technology licensing, SaaS, enterprise client and vendor agreements, and open-source license compliance.

job_description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

Your role in the team
We are seeking a Senior Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to support and enhance enterprise access management platforms that secure critical applications and digital services across the organization. This role will serve as a lead responsible for designing, configuring, implementing, and supporting commercial IAM solutions while partnering with business and technology teams to deliver secure, scalable access management capabilities.  

The ideal candidate will have strong experience with web access management and identity platforms such as IBM Verify Identity Access, IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar enterprise IAM technologies. This individual will play a key role in product strategy, solution design, vendor management, application integrations, troubleshooting, testing, issue resolution, and mentoring team members.

Key responsibilities:

• Support and guide the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of enterprise Identity and Access Management solutions, with a focus on vended access management platforms. 
• Develop technical and functional designs that address complex business requirements, application access needs, and security objectives. 
• Configure, develop within, and maintain IAM platforms that support authentication, authorization, single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access control capabilities. 
• Partner with business stakeholders, security teams, infrastructure teams, application owners, and vendor support teams to deliver secure access management solutions. 
• Contribute to product planning by creating, refining, and guiding user stories for complex features, including coaching team members who may be learning the platform or process. 
• Facilitate feature review sessions for complex business issues and requirements, document key decisions, and ensure alignment across business and technical teams. 
• Create functional designs using moderate technical skills to address complex business processes, product features, and application integration needs. 
• Support the planning, execution, and review of module, integration, and system testing for assigned features and product stories. 
• Manage issues, blockers, defects, and implementation risks through resolution for assigned features and product stories. 
• Review and validate new vendor release features, assess impact, and identify opportunities to improve platform capability and reliability. 
• Use vendor defect resolution processes, support tools, product documentation, and developer groups to troubleshoot issues and influence future product direction. 
• Evaluate proposed vendor software products and enhancements in alignment with strategic corporate direction, platform standards, and vendor roadmaps. 
• Provide knowledge and support for resolving technology issues across multiple business areas and application processes. 
• Serve as a subject matter expert for access management processes, vended IAM platforms, and related application integrations. 
• Provide training, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to strengthen team capability and bench strength. 
• Develop and maintain technical documentation, process documentation, support procedures, and implementation guidance. 

Essential Skills:

• All applicants must demonstrate they have a legal right to work in the UK for employment at Allstate. Allstate is not providing sponsorship for this vacancy.
• A minimum of 3 years of experience implementing, configuring, administering, or supporting enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, or equivalent. 
• Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise web access management or IAM platforms, such as IBM Verify Identity Access (IVIA), IBM Verify Access, IBM Security Access Manager (ISAM), IBM Verify Access Appliance or related earlier versions, Okta, ForgeRock, PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud (PAIC), Ping Access, PingFederate, PingAM, or similar vended access management tools. (Or Equivalent)
• Experience implementing and supporting single sign-on (SSO), federation, and access management solutions for enterprise applications.
• Experience writing automation scripts to complete the integration mapping automation using scripting languages, such as JavaScript, Python, Groovy, YAML or PowerShell. 
• Knowledge of common identity and access standards and protocols, including SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and federation concepts. 

Desirable Skills:

• Experience supporting large enterprise IAM or access management environments. 
• Experience with cloud-based identity platforms, SaaS application integrations, or hybrid identity environments. 
• Knowledge of directory services such as Active Directory, LDAP, or related identity stores. 
• Experience with API security, access gateways, reverse proxies, policy configuration, or application onboarding for access management platforms. 
• Familiarity with Identity Governance Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), adaptive authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), or related security technologies. 
• Experience evaluating vendor roadmaps, testing new release features, and recommending platform enhancements. 
• Relevant identity, security, cloud, or vendor certifications. 
• Experience in creating technical documentation, operational procedures, training materials, or platform standards.

This role does not have supervisory responsibilities.

job_title: Senior Content Manager, Prime Video, Live Sports EU
job_description:
Come build the future of entertainment with us.

Are you interested in shaping the future of movies and television? Do you want
to define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast
collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love
to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV
shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We
also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which
they can cancel at anytime and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets
on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business -
available in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a
dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart
of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on.

Prime Video Live Sports is looking for a Senior Content Manager to manage the
lifecycle of our live sports media assets in Europe (EU) and the Rest of the
World (ROW). Content comes from many places, such as live match footage,
multi-camera iso-feeds, highlights, all with associated metadata, and is stored
within Iconik, our media asset management (MAM) platform. We also manage
production content for live shows, such as breaks and bumpers, ensuring our
vendors are able to access these assets to make their broadcasts.

Live sports generates huge volumes of content on tight turnarounds, so you'll
need to balance speed with the long-term discipline of building an archive
that's accurate, searchable, user right management, and rights-compliant for
years to come.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage ingest, cataloging, and metadata tagging of live sports assets in
Iconik, including game/match data, teams, players, camera angles, and time-code
- Own asset quality control: verify technical specs, proxy generation, and
rights metadata before content is published and made discoverable
- Work with Vendors to ensure content is uploading to the MAM compliant with our
standards and timelines
- Work with Thumbwar to manage vendor tech in edit, storage gateways, MAM
technology and user rights for integration with live production
- Partner with live production, highlight teams/vendors, and marketing teams to
fulfill fast-turnaround asset requests before, during and immediately after live
events
- Maintain and improve sports-specific naming conventions in our MAM to support
search and discovery at speed
- Configure and maintain MAM metadata structure, collections, and automated
tagging/AI integrations to reduce manual cataloging
- Monitor storage tiers and archive policies for live footage, escalating gaps
or at-risk media
- Support post-season or post-event audits of asset libraries to identify
duplicates, missing metadata or lost content, finding fixes where possible
- Document and continuously improve live sports archive workflows, including
rapid-ingest procedures for live/near-live content

A day in the life
Pre-event, you're confirming that camera feeds and metadata templates are set up
correctly in our MAM for the match. During the event, you're managing requests
from the highlights team who need a specific content uploaded into the right
folders, checking ingests are working and landing in the right folders and
working with vendors or Thumbwar to manage any issues. Post-game, you're
reviewing the full ingest for completeness and moving to other folders if
needed, checking metadata, and updating tagging/ID if new assets have been
ingested. The work moves fast during live events and is more methodical in
between, but accuracy matters in both as teams across the business are relying
on this content being available and easily discovered.


About the team
This role sits in the Prime Video Live Sports, EU team - working along side
Content, Workflow and Ingest teams sat in the US as well as Production,
Editorial and Technology teams within the EU. There are also wider Amazon teams
that will lean on your expertise to manage assets for sponsorship and marketing
opportunities on PVLS. Basic Qualifications: - Experience with live TV/digital
- Experience leading large projects and facilitate group meetings
- Experience with data/analytics and using data to make decisions Preferred
Qualifications: - Knowledge of ProTools or other audio or video editing software

Overview

PTC is seeking an experienced, customer-focused Sr. Principal Product Manager to lead PTC Modeler and help shape the next generation of systems engineering at PTC. This role combines direct product management responsibility for an established enterprise MBSE solution with the opportunity to influence how PTC evolves beyond today's traditional modeling tools and workflows.
The role reports to the Vice President of Product Management - AI/MBSE, whose portfolio spans Codebeamer, AI, Pure Variants, and Modeler. PTC believes the future of systems engineering will require more connected, accessible, and intelligent experiences. We are exploring how AI and agentic experiences, connected engineering information, open standards, and deeper integration across the product lifecycle can create new ways for engineers to understand, design, analyze, communicate, and evolve complex systems. This Product Manager will bring the perspective of customers, practitioners, partners, and the market into that work.

This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful value for Modeler customers today while helping PTC explore what comes next for model-based and systems engineering.

• Lead finance transformation and continuous improvement across the region, simplifying processes, strengthening data and analytical capability, improving systems and management information, and embedding scalable ways of working that increase the effectiveness and impact of Finance, closely aligning to the global programme

• Successfully operated within organizations having a large international presence and been part of a global management team. • Credibility and gravitas across strategic, financial and operational discussions at a senior level

About the Role
Search is being rebuilt around AI. People increasingly get answers from AI instead of a list of links, agents run dozens of searches to answer a single question, and more than half of the traffic reaching sites on Cloudflare is now automated. Search is shifting from a destination to a utility, and Cloudflare is building the search layer for this agentic Internet.
Agentic Search at Cloudflare gives agents everything they need to find information, whether it lives in a customer’s own data or on the open web. It spans two products: AI Search for internal data, and Web Search API for the open web.
AI Search (internal data), now generally available, is the search primitive for applications and agents. It is a fully managed indexing and retrieval pipeline built on Workers AI, Vectorize, R2, and Browser Run. Developers connect a website or R2 bucket, or upload their own files, and query them with natural language through a Workers binding, REST API, or MCP server. Under the hood: continuous indexing, hybrid vector and keyword retrieval, reranking, metadata filtering, native multimodal (image) embeddings, and OCR for scanned documents. We use it to power search on our own blog and developer docs.
Web Search API (external data), now in open beta, gives agents real-time web context with a single API call. It runs on AI Gateway, so every search gets the same logging, analytics, billing, and access controls as model inference. Developers can choose from multiple search providers and always get results back in one normalized format.
Your mission in this role is to make Cloudflare the default place developers and agents go to search, across both their own data and the open web, and eventually in a single call. You’ll also help build a search ecosystem that works for AI companies, site owners, and creators alike.
What You’ll Do
Talk directly with developers, AI companies, publishers, and customers every day.
Own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Agentic Search (AI Search and Web Search API), from ingestion and indexing through retrieval, ranking, and answer generation.
Define and measure what “good search” means, including relevance, freshness, latency, and cost, and build the evals that improve it with every release.
Scale AI Search for the workloads that matter most, like multi-tenant platforms, enterprise agents, and website search, with support for billions of documents, rich media, and built-in observability.

Own pricing and packaging, and make our products first-class for agents through MCP, agent-friendly APIs, and templates like NLWeb.

Represent Cloudflare at conferences, community events, and customer and partner meetings.

Comply is the leading provider of compliance SaaS and consulting services for the global financial services sector. With more than 5,000 clients and hundreds of employees across the globe, Comply empowers Chief Compliance Officers and their teams to proactively manage regulatory obligations, mitigate risk, and scale with efficiency and confidence.

Comply serves thousands of global financial services clients including broker-dealers, insurers, investment banks, private funds, RIAs, and wealth managers who rely on Comply offerings to power their compliance programs.

To learn more about Comply, visit comply.com

About the role
Comply is looking for a Product Manager to own Comply Accountability, Comply Conduct, and Comply for T&C, the UK and European accountability suite at the heart of Comply’s international growth. Comply is the global market leader in regulatory compliance technology and consulting for financial services, serving more than 5,600 clients worldwide across investment banks, private equity firms, hedge funds, broker-dealers, and registered investment advisers. Following the 2025 acquisition of Trailight, these products are now fully integrated into the Comply portfolio, making Comply the first unified platform to connect firm compliance, employee compliance, individual accountability, and archiving across jurisdictions. They are trusted by leading financial institutions, including global Tier 1 banks—to manage individual accountability regimes, conduct oversight, competence frameworks, and Fit & Proper assessments. As the dedicated product manager, you’ll partner with Engineering, Design, Consulting, and Customer Success to evolve the products, integrate them into the broader Comply platform, and keep them setting the standard for accountability solutions globally.
You’ll love this role if you want to own a market-leading product line end to end—talking directly to compliance professionals, shaping the roadmap, and working at the front of Comply’s international expansion.
What you’ll do
• Own the product roadmap for Comply Accountability, Comply Conduct, and Comply for T&C—spanning individual accountability regime management, conduct risk oversight, competence frameworks, governance mapping, Statements of Responsibilities, and Fit & Proper assessments.
• Serve as the subject-matter expert on these product lines, their client base, and their competitive positioning within the broader Comply product organisation.
• Lead discovery with clients, compliance professionals, and internal stakeholders to understand user needs, workflow pain points, and regulatory requirements across SMCR, IAF, SEAR, FAR, MAS, and other frameworks.
• Define and prioritise product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that let Engineering and Design deliver high-quality outcomes efficiently.
• Drive the integration roadmap between these products and the broader Comply platform, including SSO, two-way data feeds, and unified risk views—for a seamless experience across the portfolio.
• Monitor product health against clear success metrics, using data and client feedback to prioritise iterations and improvements.
• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Consulting on go-to-market, client onboarding, and compelling product narratives.
• Stay ahead of the evolving regulatory landscape across the UK, Ireland, Singapore, Hong Kong, and other key markets so the products stay ahead of compliance requirements.
What success looks like in your first 90 days
• You’ve built deep fluency in Accountability, Conduct, and T&C products and met the clients and internal experts who know them best.
• You’ve refreshed and prioritised the roadmap, with a clear view of the most valuable near-term improvements and integrations.
• You’ve run your first discovery sessions and turned the insights into well-defined requirements Engineering and Design can act on.
What you’ll bring
Must-have
• 3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, ideally in RegTech, FinTech, LegalTech, or enterprise compliance software.
• Proven ability to run structured discovery, translate customer insight into product requirements, and work iteratively with Engineering and Design.
• Strong written and verbal communication—you can write a crisp PRD, facilitate a requirements workshop, and present clearly to senior stakeholders.
• A detail-oriented approach, able to manage a busy roadmap, track multiple workstreams, and make principled prioritisation decisions.
• Comfort in a dynamic environment where priorities evolve and cross-team coordination is essential.
• An empathetic, customer-first mindset—you listen carefully, ask the right questions, and keep the end user’s experience in focus.
• A practical, forward-leaning approach to AI—you use AI tools to raise your own output and think about how AI can improve accountability and conduct workflows for clients.
Nice-to-have
• Familiarity with UK financial services regulation—particularly SMCR—and/or other individual accountability regimes (IAF, SEAR, FAR, MAS, MIC).
• Direct experience working with compliance teams at financial services firms—banks, asset managers, broker-dealers, or similar.
• Experience with acquired products or product integration following M&A.
• Exposure to governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms or regulatory filing workflows.
• Understanding of accountability documentation: Statements of Responsibilities, Management Responsibilities Maps, and Reasonable Steps evidence.

At Puzzler, we're on a mission to reinvent the digital puzzle experience.
As part of an exciting product transformation, we're redesigning our B2B digital puzzle platform to create a modern, engaging, mobile-first experience that delights players while supporting the needs of our partners and clients.
We're looking for an experienced Lead Product Designer (UX/UI) with a background in gamification, gaming, puzzles, behavioural design or highly engaging digital consumer products to lead this journey. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a well-established product as we prepare to enter new markets and accelerate growth.

You'll lead the UX and UI design of key areas of the Puzzler digital experience, helping create products that are intuitive, accessible and designed with engagement at their core.

• Leading the design of modern, mobile-first digital puzzle experiences.
• Creating intuitive user journeys that balance simplicity, engagement and enjoyment.
• Applying gamification principles and behavioural design techniques to encourage repeat play and customer engagement.
• Conducting user research and translating insights into compelling product experiences.
• Producing wireframes, prototypes, user flows and high-fidelity designs.
• Developing scalable design systems that support multiple puzzle formats and partner brands.
• Collaborating closely with product, engineering and commercial stakeholders throughout delivery.
• Championing accessibility and inclusive design best practice.
• Redesigned key elements of Puzzler's white-label digital offering and delivered modern user experiences aligned to the product vision.
What Success Looks Like
By the end of the contract you will have:
• Redesigned key elements of Puzzler's white-label digital offering.
• Delivered modern user experiences aligned to the product vision.
• Established scalable and configurable design systems capable of supporting multiple puzzle types and brands.
• Enhanced engagement through thoughtful UX, visual design and gamification principles.
Requirements
What We're Looking For
Essential Experience
• Experience designing UX/UI for digital puzzles, mobile games, gaming products or highly gamified digital experiences.
• Experience creating products that use engagement mechanics such as rewards, achievements, progression systems, personalisation or habit-forming user journeys.
• Strong experience collaborating with developers throughout build, testing and delivery.
• Experience creating or evolving scalable design systems.
• A portfolio demonstrating impactful, user-centred digital product design.
Desirable Experience
• Experience working on configurable or white-label products.
• Experience supporting multiple brands, audiences or customer experiences from a common platform.
Skills & Knowledge
You'll bring:
• Expertise in UX methodologies, including user research, information architecture, journey mapping, wireframing, prototyping and usability testing.
• A strong understanding of gamification, player motivation, engagement loops and behavioural design.
• Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design principles.

job_title: Associate, Strategy & Operations, New Value Prop & Benefits
job_description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

The Value Proposition & New Benefits team owns what our core value proposition for subscription should be, and the new benefits that bring it to life. We sit within the wider Subscription EMEA org, whose vision is to create the world's leading membership programme in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world-class experience to members.

The role

We're looking for an Associarte, Strategy & Operations Manager to own strategy and execution for new benefits within Subscription. This is a hybrid strategy/build/run role: you'll define what to launch, then work cross-functionally to get it shipped and measure whether it's working. You'll be expected to move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution — this is not a role where strategy stops at a slide deck.

Typical problems you'll own:

• What new benefits should we launch for Subscription — which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each?

• How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity?

• How do we define success for a new benefit before launch — what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it?

• Once live, how is a benefit actually performing — impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction — against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next?

• How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work?

What you'll do

• Own the strategy and roadmap for new benefits within Subscription — build the analysis, the business case, and the plan, and drive it through to execution.

• Cross-functional delivery — partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Finance to take benefit ideas from concept to launch, without formal authority over any of them.

• Build and prioritise the benefit pipeline — evaluate a stream of ideas (experiential, use-case specific, or otherwise), size their potential impact and cost, and decide what's worth building next.

• Track ongoing performance — maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention.

• Scale what works — take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably.

• Bring outside-in perspective — track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context.

• Communicate to senior stakeholders — write clear strategy documents and present recommendations, trade-offs, and results to leadership.

What we're looking for

• 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, strategy consulting, or business operations — ideally with exposure to marketplaces, subscription/membership businesses, or consumer tech.

• Commercial acumen: strong understanding of marketplace dynamics and subscriber value; comfortable building a business case and owning a set of P&L-adjacent metrics.

• Analytical rigor: comfortable interpreting data and experiment results to make a clear business call — you'll partner with Data Science on the "how" and "so what."

• Bias for action and ownership: able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems ("what should we build, and how will we know it worked?"), and to drive execution personally rather than just recommend.

• Cross-functional influence: track record of aligning senior stakeholders and diverse functions (Product, Eng, Finance, Marketing) around a shared plan in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication — able to distill complex trade-offs into a clear recommendation for leadership.

Nice to have

• Multi-market experience across EMEA

• Background in a subscription, loyalty, or membership business (delivery, e-commerce, fintech, or otherwise).

Benefits (Deliveroo standard — adjust per market)

• Free Subscription

• Up to 5% matched pension contributions

• Equity / share awards eligibility

• 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing with tenure, plus 1 day paid volunteering leave

• Funded private healthcare (core plan), with option to add family

• Wellbeing perks: on-site gym / discounted gym membership, GymPass access

• Enhanced parental leave from day one

• Learning & development budget and access to RooLearn

• Cycle to Work / Season Ticket Loan schemes

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Most RL environments are simulations. Ours are not.
For two years we have recorded real commercial decisions as they happened in production, from pre-market to won deal. Each trajectory carries the state at every step and labels across 20 or more sequential decision points. Labels are emitted by our production applications and verified three ways: by real outcomes, by the accountable user, and by our own operators.
Our models are being trained for initial deployment post logging epoch completing in January 2027.
FBED Labs is completing its seed round. In 2027 we focus on two things: training regimes for our own model ladder, and task suites and RL environments for training partnerships with AI labs. We are hiring the engineer who will lead that research day to day.
What you’ll do: Build long-horizon environments and task suites from real sequential decision data; Design state representations that stay sufficient across long, partially observed trajectories; Train, post-train and evaluate our own models, from parsing models to Shannon Zero; Run rigorous evaluations against human raters and frontier models; Own the live policy and the labelling pipeline, so data collection meets the coverage that training and off-policy evaluation require; Run QA on environments delivered to lab partners and be their technical counterpart; Explore open problems in model memory: what to keep, what to consolidate and what to forget; Lead a second research engineer, working with our CTO and CEO and alongside an ML platform engineer
What you’ll bring: Hands-on experience in reinforcement learning or sequential decision modelling; Experience learning from logged data: off-policy evaluation, importance weighting and its diagnostics, such as effective sample size; A track record on long-horizon credit assignment; Working knowledge of causal inference and causal graphical models; Strong experience training and evaluating models (PyTorch or similar); Experience designing environments, benchmarks or evaluations; Comfort with messy real-world data and the judgment to make it usable
Nice to have: Post-training, reward modelling or offline RL; Experience building data or environments for model developers; Interest in memory, continual learning or long-context systems
Our commercial operation funds the lab. You get real production data, real customers and a direct line from research to deployment, without waiting on a grant cycle or a simulator.

The Role:
As a Management Accountant within our Property Finance team, you'll play a key role in managing and controlling costs across one of Europe's largest retail property portfolios.
Working closely with our Property and Finance teams, you'll be responsible for analysing and reporting on leasehold and freehold property costs across the UK and Europe. Review and challenge rent, rates, service charge and utility costs to ensure accuracy.
Maintain large property datasets and produce regular reporting for key stakeholders.
Partner with Property, Finance and external providers to resolve issues and improve processes.

About Fresha
Fresha is the leading AI-powered operating system for the global beauty and wellness industry, giving businesses everything they need to run smarter, grow faster and build stronger client relationships.
In May 2026, Fresha secured an $80M growth investment from KKR at a valuation of $1B, officially reaching unicorn status and bringing total funding raised to $285M. Already profitable, Fresha is using this investment to accelerate global expansion and drive the next generation of AI and product innovation.
Today, Fresha operates at global scale, with offices across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia Pacific. Our platform is trusted by 130,000+ beauty and wellness businesses across 120 countries, with more than 1.5 billion appointments booked to date.
Our mission is simple: help beauty and wellness businesses grow by giving them the technology they need to attract clients, manage their operations and run their business in one place.
We’re continuing to scale rapidly across markets, teams and products, making this an exciting time to join us.
Role Overview
Head of Brand and Content Marketing | London, UK | Office-based
Fresha is seeking a visionary and inspiring Head of Brand and Content Marketing to define and lead our global communications, content, and influencer programs. Reporting directly into the CEO, this role is responsible for shaping how the company tells its story across every channel, from PR and content to events and social. 
The ideal candidate is a senior leader with a proven track record in communications, digital PR, influencer marketing, and content leadership. They will combine strategic vision with hands-on delivery, bringing creative ideas to life while ensuring Fresha’s brand presence is consistent, credible, and impactful worldwide.

• Communications Leadership: Own Fresha’s communications strategy, including corporate comms, executive visibility, media engagement, and general response.

• Content Strategy & Production: Develop and oversee an integrated content strategy across corporate blog, landing pages, newsletters, and social media. Drive consistent, high-volume, high-quality output that aligns with Fresha’s values and business priorities.

• Digital PR & Media: Manage PR agencies to deliver measurable media coverage and digital backlinks that strengthen Fresha’s reputation and SEO authority.

• Influencer & Ambassador Programs: Design and scale global influencer and ambassador initiatives that amplify Fresha’s reach and credibility.

• Event Marketing & Thought Leadership: Lead communications for conferences, panels, and speaking opportunities. Shape messaging that positions Fresha as the category leader in beauty and wellness tech.

• Digital PR & Media: Strong ability to generate media coverage and digital visibility that drives measurable outcomes

• Influencer marketing: Built and managed influencer/ambassador programs at scale that help brands connect authentically with their communities.

• Executive influence: Confident working directly with the CEO and senior leadership.

Focus: Account Expansion, Upsell/Cross-sell, Renewals & Churn Mitigation
About the Role
This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role based out of our vibrant London hub in Hatton Garden, Farringdon, dedicated to driving revenue growth and account expansion across a defined portfolio of paying customers in the Netherlands.
As a Lead Account Manager at Freshworks, you will be obsessive about customer ROI and real business value realization. Managing a horizontal book of strategic accounts spanning SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise tiers, you will act as a trusted advisor capable of commanding conversations across the spectrum—from hands-on IT teams to C-suite leaders and CIOs.
Operating with a true Account Team / Pod mentality, you will partner hand-in-glove with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to maximize product adoption, safeguard renewals, mitigate churn risk, and unlock substantial ARR growth through multi-product cross-selling and upselling across our core platforms and latest acquired technologies.
What You’ll Do
• Drive ARR Expansion & Retention: Own commercial growth, renewal execution, and expansion across your assigned book of Dutch accounts, exceeding net-new ARR and quota targets.

• Orchestrate Seamless POD Collaboration: Work in tight alignment with your dedicated Customer Success Managers (CSMs) in an integrated Pod structure—combining forces to drive deep product adoption, identify health red flags early, and eliminate churn risk.

• Master Value-Led Expansion: Champion the core Freshworks portfolio—anchored by our flagship ITSM suite—while capitalizing on our latest strategic acquisitions to bring cutting-edge solutions to market, uncover high-impact use cases, and significantly expand customer ARR.

• Engage IT to CIOs: Serve as a credible, consultative partner who can dive deep into technical workflows with IT teams and seamlessly elevate conversations to deliver strategic, board-level impact briefings to CIOs and executive sponsors.

• End-to-End Renewal Management: Own commercial renewal cycles from strategy through procurement negotiation and contract execution, ensuring predictable forecasting and zero surprise churn.

• Account Roadmapping & Strategy: Analyze usage telemetry, support metrics, and business drivers to formulate tailored growth and uptick roadmaps for every tier of account in your horizontal portfolio.

• Strategic In-Region Travel: Travel to the Netherlands from time to time as needed for executive business reviews (EBRs), CIO alignment sessions, and strategic customer events.

• Pipeline Hygiene & Forecasting: Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene, delivering reliable expansion pipeline and ARR forecasts to sales leadership.

What You’ll Bring
• SaaS Account Management Track Record: 7+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS account management or direct sales experience, with a proven history of growing ARR through account expansion, cross-selling, and client retention.

• Proven CIO-Level Credibility: Verified track record of engaging, presenting to, and negotiating with multiple CIOs and C-level executives, backed by the ability to connect technical capabilities to executive business priorities.

• Technical & Domain Depth: Strong background in IT Service Management (ITSM) and modern enterprise cloud software, with deep comfort speaking the language of IT practitioners, infrastructure teams, and IT leadership.

• Portfolio Agility: Demonstrated versatility managing a horizontal portfolio of accounts, adept at driving high-velocity growth across SMB/Mid-Market while running complex, multi-threaded expansions in Enterprise accounts.

• Account Team Mentality: Collaborative spirit with proven experience working closely alongside CSMs, Solution Engineers, Support, and Professional Services to drive holistic customer success.

• Languages: Full professional fluency in English is mandatory; fluency in Dutch is a definite advantage/plus.

• Strategic Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel to the Netherlands from time to time when in-person presence creates a strategic advantage.

• Education: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (or equivalent practical experience) is desirable.

Working Model, Culture & Perks
• Prime London Hub: Based in the heart of Hatton Garden, Farringdon, surrounded by top dining, coffee spots, and excellent transport links.

• Hybrid Balance: 3 days in-office (Monday, Wednesday, Thursday) collaborating with your team and Pods, and 2 days remote (Tuesday, Friday).

• Incredible Culture: An open, collaborative, and high-energy environment that celebrates wins, supports continuous career development, and fosters true cross-functional alignment.

Are you ready to help shape the future of the electricity grid — working with major utility customers to define where they need to go and how they can get there?

GE Vernova is looking for an Enterprise Architect to join our Grid Solutions Global Enterprise Architecture team.

GE Vernova — The Energy to Change the World
With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonise it. Our name reflects our mission. "GE" carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. "Ver" signals Earth's lush ecosystems, while "Nova" nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver. Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life. Our Electrification solutions modernise grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks.

Let's Talk about the Role
We are looking for an Enterprise Architect to help utility customers shape and accelerate their digital transformation journey across IT and OT domains. In this role, you will engage directly with customer stakeholders to understand business goals, facilitate strategic discussions, and translate transformation needs into actionable roadmaps, business requirements, and architecture recommendations.

This role is part of GE Vernova's Grid Software business global Enterprise Architecture team and supports the growth of our strategic consulting capability for utility customers. While the primary focus is strategic consulting, the role is expected to maintain strong awareness of solution architecture, delivery context, and enterprise feasibility to help customers move from strategy to actionable outcomes.

Based in Edinburgh and working in a hybrid pattern, you will support customers primarily across the UK and Europe, with travel of approximately 20–25% for customer visits, workshops, and regional events.

You will be supported by a team of experienced senior architects and will have opportunities to grow your strategic consulting, customer engagement, and architecture skills through hands-on mentoring and exposure to complex, high-impact utility transformation programs.

Job Description
What You’ll Do
· Support and contribute to strategic consulting engagements with utility customers focused on digital transformation and enterprise architecture alignment
· Facilitate workshops and advisory sessions with customer stakeholders
· Produce customer-facing deliverables such as strategic roadmaps, BRDs, transition roadmaps, and advisory recommendations
· Translate business priorities into practical architecture direction and transformation plans
· Help shape enterprise opportunities by aligning customer needs with feasible and value-driven solution approaches
· Collaborate with internal teams across Sales, Presales, Product Management, Engineering, and Services
· Engage subject matter experts across cyber, cloud, infrastructure, data, and solution domains as needed
· Help develop reusable consulting methods, assets, and playbooks that improve the consistency of strategic engagements

What You Bring
· Extensive experience in architecture, consulting, solution strategy, or digital transformation roles
· Broad understanding of enterprise architecture across business, data, application, and technology domains
· Strong familiarity with utility environments and mission-critical utility solutions such as ADMS, AEMS/EMS, DERMS, or similar domains
· Experience facilitating workshops and engaging customer stakeholders in strategic discussions
· Experience creating customer-facing deliverables such as roadmaps, requirements documents, and recommendations
· Strong communication, listening, and presentation skills
· Ability to connect business outcomes with architecture and transformation strategy
· Ability to work across teams and engage technical SMEs when needed

A formal education and subsequent University Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant subject is a nice to have, but we are most interested in your total experience and professional achievements. Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as TOGAF is beneficial, though practical customer-facing architecture experience is what matters most.

Preferred Qualifications
· Utility industry experience
· Experience supporting IT/OT transformation initiatives
· Experience in strategic consulting or enterprise deal shaping
· Familiarity with architecture and technology topics such as cloud, infrastructure, integration, cybersecurity, and non-functional requirements

Why This Role Matters
This role helps customers move from transformation vision to practical action. You will play a key part in building trusted customer relationships, shaping strategic opportunities, and helping define the future architecture direction of mission-critical utility environments

Where and How You'll Work
This is a permanent position based from Edinburgh office. We have a hybrid working model which gives you the flexibility to work from the office and from home — typically with two to three days per week in the office. We're big on collaboration and connection, so regular in-person time is an important part of how we work together and build strong customer relationships.

Our Culture
Every action shapes our future. That's why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve. Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify and decarbonise the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy. Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world's electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change.

We're determined to be the best place to grow. We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We're committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey. We also prioritise fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programmes for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.

Inclusion & Diversity
We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone. As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to supporting disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike. Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging.

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Candidates should be aware that this role involves a client's critical infrastructure; shortlisted candidates would therefore be subject to heightened security checks as directed by our clients. All personal data will be handled with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with our data protection policies, solely for recruitment and security purposes.

Job Description
We are looking for a commercially driven and forward-thinking Finance Project Controller & Business Partner to join our team in a pivotal role supporting the full Order to Remittance (OTR) process. 

This is an excellent opportunity for a talented finance professional who wants to move beyond traditional reporting and play a visible role in driving business performance, influencing decision-making, and partnering with operational leaders.
Working closely with both Finance and Operations, you will take ownership of the end-to-end financial management of the revenue cycle — from order booking through to cash collection — helping to ensure strong financial control, process excellence, and improved contract performance.

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, adds value through collaboration and commercial insight, and is motivated by delivering operational and financial excellence.

About the role

As Finance Project Controller & Business Partner, you will play a key role in ensuring the effective, accurate, and compliant execution of finance activities across the OTR lifecycle. You will partner closely with operational stakeholders to improve financial visibility, strengthen performance management, and identify opportunities to drive efficiency and value.
You will bring together financial rigour, commercial insight, and strong stakeholder engagement to support project and contract success, while helping to embed best practice across processes and controls.

Roles and Responsibilities
• Finance Business Partnering
• Lead and oversee the end-to-end O2R process including order validation, billing, collections.
• Ensure timely and accurate invoicing and revenue recognition in line with accounting standards and company policies.
• Manage CMR process compliantly with a view to maximising positive P&L impact.
• Partner with business units to streamline O2R processes and resolve issues.
• Support the implementation and enhancement of financial systems, automation tools, and reporting dashboards.
• Ensure compliance with SOX/internal controls, audit requirements, and local regulations.
• Support transformation initiatives related to O2R process efficiency and digital enablement.
• Provide insights and reporting to senior finance leadership on Project performance, working capital, customer payment trends, and operational KPIs.

Required Qualifications:

• Finance experience preferably within projects business
• Part Qualified/Newly qualified ACCA/CIMA
• Strong understanding of cost accounting, ERP systems.
• Strong understanding of revenue recognition (IFRS 15 or ASC 606), billing systems, and AR controls.
• Proficiency in Excel, financial modelling, and data analysis tools (Power BI, Tableau a plus).
• Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Experience in stakeholder management across commercial, legal, and operational teams

Desired Characteristics:

• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills
• Strategic thinking with attention to operational detail
• Results-oriented with a drive for continuous improvement
• Ability to influence and support non-finance stakeholders

You can expect from us:

• Challenging and exciting projects
• A work environment where we understand that not everyone has the same expectations about their jobs, careers and work-life balance and we are happy to discuss flexibility requirements.
• Attractive compensation
• Flexible benefits so you can build a package that fits your personal needs. Some core benefits are: Employer pension contribution (not subject to individual contribution); Income protection; Private Health Insurance; Life Assurance
• 26 days vacation + bank holidays

Additional Information
Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Why GE Vernova
